key_messages: Drier, cooler air will persist through much of the weekend, with central Florida mostly precipitation free thru at least Sunday afternoon.
Conditions trend gradually wetter Monday and Tuesday as the next front sinks into central Florida.
Prolonged river flooding continues along the St. Johns River, with all points in east central Florida in Major Flood Stage. Additional rises following recent rainfall cannot be ruled out.
afd.hydrology: River flood warnings remain in effect for Cocoa (COCF1), Geneva (GENF1), Astor (ASTF1), Deland (DLAF1), and Sanford (SNFF1) on the St. Johns River. All five river points are actively in Major Flood Stage. Prolonged flooding impacts along the St. Johns are anticipated and any additional rainfall across the basin may lead to additional rises. River forecasts out five days are issued twice daily by the NWS Southeast River Forecast Center in collaboration with NWS Melbourne and are available at water.noaa.gov/wfo/MLB.
